description: Tess OS second brain (scripts/brain/tessbrain.py). Codex runs project hooks only after the project is trusted and these hooks are approved in /hooks; approval is hash-pinned, so these lines never change. Each line is a guarded no-op outside a git work tree or when the brain script is absent.

hooks.command: sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && f="$r/scripts/brain/tessbrain.py" && [ -f "$f" ] && exec python3 "$f" hook session-start --runtime codex; exit 0'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && f="$r/scripts/brain/tessbrain.py" && [ -f "$f" ] && exec python3 "$f" hook prompt --runtime codex; exit 0'
sh -c 'r=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && f="$r/scripts/brain/tessbrain.py" && [ -f "$f" ] && exec python3 "$f" hook stop --runtime codex; echo {}; exit 0'
